long_biography.plain_text:
Raised around Jensen Construction's bridge crews, Rasmussen worked in the enterprise while attending school. A Grand View College graduate, he entered full-time site work in 1991, travelling to southern projects before assuming responsibility for Jensen's regional division and Circle V Specialized. Among the assignments he supervised were complex lake-bridge and interstate heavy-haul projects.

When the family sold Jensen's northern and southern bridge operations, Rasmussen helped refocus its remaining holdings on construction materials and highway support. That transition broadened an inheritance rooted in a century-old contractor into an interlocking collection of paving, concrete, quarrying, trucking and fabrication businesses. His present mandate is to visit sites, solve operating problems and support teams throughout the portfolio.
